name: Carrot
fix_description: Add onlyOwner modifier to transReward(). Currently any caller can execute arbitrary function calls on the pool contract via functionCall(data), allowing them to drain pool funds.
difficulty_reasoning: This is a short, mostly direct exploit: call an unprotected function to gain privileged ownership-like control, then use the token’s flawed transferFrom logic to steal tokens and swap them. It involves only a few external calls and no flash loans, timing, or deep protocol-specific accounting.
